summary: Reviewer says the new SAFF bottle is too big to carry around, and the old bottle leaked several times.
Retailer guide on choosing long-lasting SAFF scents addresses the 'scent fades fast' complaint and warns about fake products.
Second retailer article on SAFF longevity, stressing skin chemistry and that long-lasting does not mean strong sillage.
Irai Leima reviewed as clean, elegant aquatic-floral; fairly long-lasting and often repurchased.
SAFF & Co. named among top local fragrance brands of 2026 next to HMNS, Mykonos and Project 1945.
Academic study cites about 266,680 Shopee reviews for SAFF with a 4.94 average; rating mattered more than review text for purchase intent.
Coco reviewers praise long wear, fair price, large size and easy availability.
Unrosed praised as a powdery, slightly spicy rose that is not sweet and lasts long.
Orgasm reviewer says a little goes a long way and it lasts on clothes.
Paradise liked as a soft daily scent; fans cite wide choice and travel sizes.
Rouge reviewer finds it very oily, lasting 3–4 hours; would not repurchase.
Fresh Book Passion reviewer says it lasts only 1–2 hours and the dry-down disappears.
Alchemist launches Out West collection with IFF perfumers; brand cites Best Perfume Brand Indonesia wins in 2022 and 2024.
Most 2026 S.O.T.B reviews praise its warm floral-vanilla scent and 6–8 hour wear; one April review calls it heady and too common now.
Latest Loui review finds it long-lasting but strong enough to cause headaches; an April reviewer says the new bottle is harder to carry.
Xocolatl (4.7, 97% recommend) praised as a soft, non-cloying gourmand; one recent review looks machine-written, a review-quality risk.
Cascavel (reformulated 2023) has the lowest recommend rate seen (86%); recent reviewers split, with weak longevity a repeat point.
Minouet reviewers like its sweet unisex scent, good wear in heat and the new packaging; one plans to repurchase after a sale.
New 2026 scent Eulalie scores 7.0/10 from 10 Parfumo ratings, with the bottle rated lowest (5.9) and longevity 6.6.
Third Lazada guide on picking SAFF scents that last all day in hot weather, featuring Eulalie and Troupe.
Cloud Mist Sonnet rates 4.8 from 1,165 ratings (94% satisfied); buyers like the bottle and fast delivery, a few note dented boxes.
SAFF launched Kirithra with an inclusive art studio whose artists with disabilities designed the merchandise.
Writer likes HMNS scents but says they fade in about 2 hours and the spray nozzle often fails; won't rebuy.
Alchemist invited to Esxence 2026 in Milan, framed as a first for an Indonesian niche fragrance label.
When In Paris (3.9, 17 reviews) liked as a fresh citrus scent for hot weather in a compact, bag-friendly size.
Onix ran a large Ramadan giveaway and positions its 13 scents for Indonesia's humid climate.
Troupe holds 4.6 from 95 reviews (95% recommend); newer reviews like the upgraded packaging but some report only 4–5 hours on skin and call the scent common due to dupes.
SAFF & Co. launched in Japan via selected Don Quijote stores and an online store, with ten Extrait scents in 8 ml bottles at 1,650 yen.
Co-founder interview says Malaysia is the first target for regional expansion and cites over 2 million products sold.
Am Kamin (2025) has no community ratings yet; the only statement scores scent 10/10 and describes an incense, spicy-fruity character.
Listicle recommends five SAFF women's scents (Loui, Las Pozas, Xocolatl, Ostara, Chno) as long-lasting and affordable at about Rp208k–237k.
Retailer guide explains how to spot fake SAFF bottles (batch code, hologram, box print, spray) and advises buying from official stores.
Watsons lists S.O.F.R Extrait in a 35 ml size at Rp249,000, with no shopper ratings shown yet.
HMNS x SORE Eterna rates 4.4 from 17 reviews with 100% recommend; reviewers note a bright citrus opening and about 6–8 hours of wear.
Mykonos Luminos rates 4.7 from 11 reviews; fans like the soft fresh scent and glow-in-dark bottle, but one cites frequent stock-outs and reseller markups.
Alchemist Musc Vanille has 5.0 from 4 reviews; the latest praises sturdy leak-free packaging and fair price for quality.
Onix Gala Extrait rates 5.0 from 3 reviews; reviewers call it long-lasting, affordable and unisex, best for evening or indoor use.
Compas data for Q2 2026 puts SAFF 4th by Shopee perfume market share (3.53%), behind Mykonos (6.78%), Scarlett and HMNS (5.09%).
Chno holds 4.3 from 100 reviews with 96% recommend; recent reviewers like its soft, creamy dry-down that clings to clothes.
A creator review praises new scent Eulalie as soft, addictive and less mainstream than typical local perfumes.
An 'honest review' post tests whether a SAFF best-seller is worth the hype or just viral; full verdict not visible in search.
Retailer review describes Minouet as sweet but not heavy, with a creamy vanilla dry-down and a sturdy black bottle in a pink box.
Brand blog introduces the 'For Now and Then' pair, Traumerei (citrus-amber) and Am Kamin (woody-leather); page now shows no stock.
Regional feature on Indonesian perfume brands calls Alchemist super viral and picks Home Garden, Got My Mojo Back and Pink Laundry; SAFF is not featured.
UK reseller blog credits TikTok and Instagram reels for Mykonos going viral and notes reseller prices rising on demand.
HMNS launched two film-tie-in scents (Zena, Eterna) across online and stores, with free testers for movie ticket holders.
Onix sells a Blibli-exclusive 2026 duo pack tied to the Jakarta Fair, bundling two bottle sizes.
SAFF's Deo Potion antiperspirant comes in four perfume-inspired scents at about Rp109k; the 48-hour headline claim is not explained in the article.
SAFF launched two new Extrait collections, ALENCINE and MECHLINE, pairing scent with art around different female character types.
Ostara (4.1, 92% recommend): recent reviews report 5+ hours of wear, but one says the all-black bottle hides how much is left and some find it too strong.
Omnia holds 4.5 with 98% recommend; recent reviewers praise a fresh-to-sweet drydown that lasts all day, especially on clothes.
Article credits SAFF's virality mainly to TikTok reviews, live shopping and flash sales; Instagram is linked but not named as a driver.
Alchemist ran an immersive OUT WEST exhibition at Plaza Senayan and launched ABSOLU with a K-music artist as face of the line.
HMNS founder says storytelling drives the brand and Shopee makes up about 60% of its sales.
Bonfire Vanilla (4.1, 93% recommend): reviewers like a warm, not-too-sweet vanilla with 6–8 hours on skin at an affordable price.
Onix FWB (4.1, 96% recommend): fans call it a long-lasting citrus-musk and one wished they had bought the larger size.
Men's grooming list of five local amberwood perfumes includes SAFF Eulalie next to HMNS Ambar Janma and Mykonos Luminos, praising its staying power without giving hours.
Las Pozas holds 4.6 on 91 reviews (96% recommend); green-woody scent and cute packaging are praised, though some get only 5–6 hours.
Lifestyle article frames Troupe, Omnia and Loui as affordable alternatives to designer perfumes, at about Rp132k–190k per 30 ml.
Buying-guide ranking of top 10 SAFF products, led by S.O.T.B, Ostara and Omnia, based on marketplace best-sellers.
Older business piece: SAFF's strategy against rising local competition rests on loyal customers, signature scents, longevity and its compact black bottle.
Untitled Humans rates 4.5 on 12 reviews; woody fig scent is liked, but longevity is mixed and one reviewer finds the cap fragile.
Mexicola rates 4.2 on 53 reviews (92% recommend); sweet coconut-vanilla scent lasts well but can feel heavy in daytime heat.
Indian retailer guide markets Mykonos as Indonesia's viral brand with 8–12 hour claims, showing export reach beyond Southeast Asia.
Design outlet covers the ALENCINE and MECHLINE boxes, illustrated by Nindita Kirana with a hummingbird that turns into a woman when opened, plus merch.
ALENCINE (woody-floral) and MECHLINE (floral-citrus-musk) are priced at Rp409k, well above core Extraits, and on sale in Indonesia and Malaysia from 25 Oct.
June 2026 launch round-up lists SAFF Postojna (35 ml, Rp349k) next to four new Mykonos scents and Alchemist's Out West trio at Rp579k–789k.
Older feature credits TikTok live shopping and a TikTok-exclusive variant for making SAFF and Mykonos top perfume brands on the platform.
Shower Potion Ode to Ostara has 5.0 from 2 reviews; users like layering it with the perfume for all-day scent, though one finds it a bit pricey.
Creator post reviews Xocolatl, S.O.T.B, Las Pozas and Iliad and calls them among the tastiest, longest-lasting local perfumes (snippet only).
Got My Mojo Back holds 4.5 on 101 reviews (98% recommend); recent reviewers report 5–8 hours, but one found the full bottle sharper than the sample.
Round-up of seven HMNS collaborations (artists, musicians, a film) priced about Rp185k–398k, showing heavy use of partner launches.
Lists seven SAFF scents for women and prices ALENCINE and MECHLINE at Rp319k, below the Rp409k reported at launch.
Profiles LOUI as a soft fresh-floral musk unisex scent, about Rp209k on sale vs Rp249k normal; no longevity claim.
Retailer guide on spotting fake SAFF bottles: check batch code, hologram and box quality, and avoid unusually cheap sellers.
Shower Potion Sanctum on the Beach rates 5.0 from only 2 reviews; scent lingers after showering and skin does not feel dry.
Local extrait round-up: SAFF Morfosia (Rp249k) praised for packaging but given no wear time, while HMNS, Mykonos and Alchemist get hour claims.
Lists SAFF among most-sought local perfumes with sweet floral-fruity scents, 6–8 hour wear and Rp199k–219k pricing.
Korean singer DPR IAN fronts Alchemist's OUT WEST campaign, with queues at a Jakarta pop-up and an international push.
Onix Gratitude rates 4.2 (23 reviews, 95% recommend) for a clean scent lasting 6–8+ hours; same plain bottle across variants.
HMNS price guide: mostly 100 ml EDPs from Rp195k to Rp510k (Ambar Janma), plus a Rp289k discovery set.
Blogger praises Mykonos wear time and value but says several scents are poor dupes and better judged on their own.
Men's woody list picks SAFF Maleali as deep, smoky and long-lasting, next to HMNS Alpha and Alchemist Out West.
Floral list includes SAFF Ostara as sweet and long-lasting, alongside Mykonos Enchanted and Alchemist Galleria.
Reviewer likes S.O.F.R as a softer S.O.T.B with about six hours indoors, but notes weak projection outdoors.
Solaris holds 4.6 with 100% recommend; praised for wear time and value, but the dark bottle hides the fill level.
Covers the Heavenly Potions body care launch: four shower gels and four lotions with 5% niacinamide in SAFF scents.
Reports the For Now and Then Cloud Mist duo (Träumerei, Am Kamin) built around nostalgia; no price given.
Lists six unisex SAFF scents by note profile, calling the line long-lasting but giving no prices or wear times.
Zalora lists Maleali at Rp229k vs Rp299k normal, so the scent is sold at a steady discount.
Zalora lists Morfosia at Rp249k vs Rp349k normal, a 29% markdown on a newer scent.
Mykonos teams with NCT Haechan on Soft Hour, with a Jakarta fan event 6–8 Nov and sales from 11 Nov.
Fan account reshares the Mykonos Instagram reveal of Soft Hour with Haechan, driving K-pop fan buzz.
New-launch list: Alchemist Out West x DPR Ian at Rp579k–679k, above three Mykonos launches at Rp239k–335k.
A 6 Nov guide lists seven SAFF scents incl. ALENCINE and MECHLINE at Rp319k and older scents around Rp202k–239k, and advises using Loui sparingly because it is strong.
A gourmand perfume roundup picks SAFF Xocolatl next to Alchemist Got My Mojo Back, Onix Mexicola and Mykonos Pandan Sticky Rice.
A local perfume list cites SAFF Extrait at up to 6 hours from Rp88.9k, below the 7 hours it cites for HMNS Essence of the Sun.
VOI names SAFF and Mykonos as local brands often featured by TikTok creators, with SAFF launching Maleali in the 12.12 campaign.
GoodStats charts top-selling local perfume brands on e-commerce (May–Jul 2024) and cites a report of SAFF revenue up to Rp27bn a year.
Enchanted holds 4.3 on 118 reviews (97% recommend); recent reviewers like the soft floral scent but several buy on discount and note re-spraying.
Alchemist launched The New Out West A.M and P.M with artist DPR IAN at Rp579k–679k, sold only via C&F stores and site.
Onix Jack has a single 4.0 review praising a clean woody masculine scent but rating longevity as only average.
A TikTok-viral perfume list features HMNS Orgsm and Alpha plus Mykonos California and Aphrodite; SAFF is not on the list.
Kirithra holds 4.7 from 9 reviews (100% recommend); reviewers like the honey-amber scent, long wear and sprayer, but find it heavy in daytime heat.
Rae Nira (cajuput-sandalwood) has 5.0 from only 4 reviews, praised as warm and nostalgic; one review came from a PR package.
Irai Leima stays at 4.7 (88% recommend), but 3 of the 5 latest reviews do not recommend it, citing a too-aquatic or spicy opening; two look duplicated.
ILIAD rates 4.6 (90% recommend); some reviewers say projection is weak for an Extrait and note oily residue on clothes and bottle.
A floral-powdery list picks SAFF Omnia at Rp179k as an office and event scent, alongside cheaper rivals from Rp58k.
ALENCINE and MECHLINE debuted at a Blok M pop-up on 16 Oct, with sales from 25 Oct in Indonesia and Malaysia and illustrated boxes.
Tokopedia's TikTok-viral perfume list includes SAFF S.O.T.B next to HMNS Orgsm and two Mykonos scents.
Detik covered SAFF's cajuput collection, positioned as perfumes with a distinctly Indonesian scent.
Medcom embeds Mykonos' Instagram reel for Soft Hour with NCT Haechan; online sales start 11 Nov and stores 15 Nov.
A Mykonos EU store lists Soft Hour x NCT Haechan as a new Extrait coming to Europe.
Alchemist closed its Out West trilogy with Out West Absolu, launched with DPR IAN at a Plaza Senayan exhibition.
SAFF's official Instagram profile ranks top for 'viral perfume influencer' searches; page itself not readable, so no post-level detail.
Creator review frames Maleali as a strongly masculine scent for men (title only; video not readable).
Maleali rates 4.1 on 27 reviews (88% recommend): woody-smoky, near all-day wear and frequent promos; one reviewer dislikes the sandalwood.
The Postojna Project: a multisensory pop-up with VR pods and sniffing bar at Kota Kasablanka to launch Postojna Extrait, with RAN as muse.
ALENCINE (woody-floral-amber) and MECHLINE (floral-citrus-musk) launched under The Pink Society campaign, with merch sold only 16–27 Oct at Blok M.
Kirithra launch paired with artists with disabilities from an inclusive studio for visuals and merch, building a purpose-led brand image.
Indonesian retailer lists 33 SAFF items incl. 8 ml travel sizes at Rp75k–109k and 35 ml at Rp209k–269k, some 5–10% off.
Irai Leima ranked #1 in a long-lasting local women's perfume list, ahead of Onix Mexicola, Mykonos Aphrodite and HMNS Orgsm.
Retailer blog promotes the 'Soft Hour On Air' launch experience at Lotte Mall Jakarta, 6–8 Nov, with free entry and sniffing.
Roundup of six iconic HMNS collaborations (Tsana, Christian Sugiono, Maliq, Sore film), illustrated with posts from HMNS's Instagram.
HMNS Theta rates 4.4 on 8 reviews (87% recommend): clean woody scent that softens after 4–5 hours.
Champagne Blush has one review (3.0, not recommended): sweet-fruity scent felt too common to buy.
Case study: Onix grew through Instagram and influencer co-created scents; one collab sold 1,000+ bottles in 30 minutes.
Long-lasting perfume roundup lists S.O.T.B as a soft vanilla-floral for formal events, up to 8 hours and gentle on sensitive skin.
Cloud Mist Annabel Lee (4.7, 30 reviews): lychee-tea scent is loved, but several recent reviewers say it fades within minutes to hours.
Cloud Mist Sonnet 116 (5.0, 8 reviews): fresh tea-jasmine scent lasting about 4 hours; one reviewer says the square cap is hard to close.
Kie Raha 35 ml rated 4.9 from 393 ratings on the official store, discounted 20% to Rp239k with a free vial for 11.11.
Morfosia 35 ml listed at Rp249k with a gift-while-stock-lasts promo during Watsons 11.11 bundle deals; no ratings shown.
Creator reviews almost the full mini-size range, picks Loui, Maleali and Xocolatl, and recommends minis before buying full bottles.
Ostara rated 9.5/10: fruity-floral with warm base, 6–8 hours on skin, and good value at about Rp219k for 30 ml.
S.O.T.B praised as elegant tropical-floral lasting 7–8 hours; downsides are that it is common and often sold out.
Third-party seller from Indonesia lists Irai Leima at US$78, far above local price, with no authorised-reseller proof.
List of top Indonesian perfume influencers notes one often features SAFF S.O.T.B for its creamy floral character.
Community wear report for SAFF puts longevity at about 4–6 hours with modest sillage, scent 3.6/5, value 3.8.
UK retailer launches Mykonos, pitching it as a viral, dupe-friendly Indonesian brand with about 700k Instagram followers.
Milk Drops (4.0, 41 reviews, 85% recommend): latest reviewer finds it faint with weak projection; earlier ones report 6–8 hours.
Alchemist x DPR IAN New Out West A.M and P.M launched at Rp579k–679k, sold only via C&F stores and online.
Scent of a Woman sits at 3.7 with 64% recommend; reviewers like the floral but note it is hard to find or discontinued.
Shower Potion Loui's Lullaby has one 5-star review praising a soft, clean floral scent, good lather and no dry skin after use.
Shower Potion Las Pozas has one 5-star review (from a PR package) liking the lasting scent, glitter look and moisturising feel.
Retailer guide on picking SAFF scents for office and travel cites about 6–8 hours of wear in hot weather.
A skincare reseller lists Cascavel 30 ml at Rp189k but shows it as sold out, with no reviews or authenticity statement.
Watsons sells Kirithra 35 ml at Rp246k after a 5% discount (from Rp259k), with a gift while stock lasts and no reviews shown.
Zalora's long-lasting local perfume list features SAFF Las Pozas, S.O.T.B, Omnia and Postojna next to HMNS, Mykonos and Alchemist.
Omnia's community profile shows short wear (about 3 hours) and intimate sillage, though no written reviews yet.
Xocolatl rates 4.9 from about 4,960 ratings on SAFF's official store (under 0.5% are 1–2 stars), now 24% off at Rp227k.
Watsons carries an 8 ml travel size of S.O.F.R at Rp95k, giving shoppers a cheaper way to try the scent.
Long-lasting local perfume guide ranks SAFF S.O.T.B first (up to 6 hours, from Rp299k) and flags HMNS Alpha as less long-lasting.
Article credits TikTok live shopping and an exclusive 12.12 variant (Maleali) with making SAFF a top perfume brand on TikTok.
Parenting site review of S.O.T.B says the scent lasts up to about 6 hours.
Onirique holds 4.7 on 41 reviews (95% recommend); the latest reviewer likes the strength and price but gets about 6 hours, not the claimed 8–12.
Senoparty sits at 4.0 on 30 reviews (80% recommend); fans like the evening scent and ~6-hour wear, one calls it overrated.
Maleali on the official Tokopedia store scores 4.9 from about 1,550 ratings, with only ~0.2% at 1–2 stars; buyers praise a soft woody scent and leak-free packing.
ILIAD scores 4.9 from about 2,900 Tokopedia ratings at 23% off (Rp229k); most praise wear time, though one buyer found it shorter than other SAFF scents.
A third-party shop sells an 'inspired by' copy of SAFF Coco using the SAFFNCO name at Rp95k, with 53 ratings averaging 4.9.
Festival-scent roundup picks Irai Leima (aquatic floral, about Rp246k) alongside HMNS ORGSM and Mykonos Sorento.
Watsons lists Solaris 30ml at Rp179.5k (18% off) but the page appears to show it as out of stock.
Feature on The POSTOJNA Project exhibition at Kota Kasablanka, noting the scent was made with a Bulgarian perfumer and the bottle designed in-house.
Music outlet covers the SAFF x RAN Postojna launch and immersive activation, describing SAFF as a brand that keeps creating buzz.
Creator post recommends Ostara, Chno, Solaris and Las Pozas as long-lasting, with tips to apply on pulse points.
Unpatched holds 4.8 on 12 reviews (100% recommend); reviewers like the bitter-chocolate gourmand and report around 8 hours.
TikTok-viral list features HMNS Orgsm and Alpha (about 6 hours), Mykonos California and Aphrodite, and SAFF S.O.T.B.
Citing Compas Q2 2026 Shopee data, SAFF ranks 4th among local perfume brands with 3.52% share, behind Mykonos (6.75%), Scarlett and HMNS (5.06%).
Official-store S.O.F.R scores 4.9 from about 1,500 ratings (about 1% low stars), listed 29% off at Rp247.4k.
Watsons lists Coco 30ml at Rp199k with no customer reviews shown on the page.
A non-official Tokopedia shop sells Troupe 30ml at Rp199k with no official-store badge or authorisation shown.
Parfumo lists 29 SAFF scents; 2026 launches Postojna and Eulalie have no community ratings yet.
Creator post praises three Cloud Mist scents; Remedia Amoris lasts about 4–5 hours on skin and 150ml seen as good value.
Recommends Saff, Solaris, Las Pozas and Coco for men's daily wear; says Las Pozas lasts about six hours.
HMNS Cherlavie appears as a 2026 unisex release on Parfumo with no ratings or reviews yet.
Blogger reviews seven Mykonos scents favourably, picking Down To Earth as favourite; bought some bottles secondhand.
Alchemist's first extrait, Out West (40% concentration), launched at Rp279k for 50ml as its longer-lasting option.
